items.name: Adaeze O.
items.text: Tiana is an absolute genius! My red stilettos were the talk of the whole event. Everyone kept asking for her contact. 10/10 every single time!

items.name: Chisom N.
items.text: My lashes have never looked this good. She's so precise and careful. The result is stunning and they've lasted 3 weeks without any issues!

items.name: Funmi A.
items.text: The French tip with tiny hearts on my ring finger — I literally cried. Such attention to detail. Tiana doesn't miss. Best nail tech in Lagos!
